components.name: method
values: mosaic platform | spheroids of mixed 50 cancer cell lines cultured in suspension treated with drugs or dmso for 24h dissociated fixed and profiled using parse gigalab kit for combinatorial barcoding scrna-seq. snp-based deconvolution for cell line assignment.

scrna-seq data processing | sequencing of sublibraries 72-165 per plate from 14 plates 1.4 trillion raw reads 153 million cells. filtering criteria minimal filters 100.6m cells and full filters 95.6m cells .

components.name: name
values: generating the tahoe-100m atlas using vevo s mosaic platform

components.name: task
values: 14 96-well plates of spheroids were seeded and drug treated. barcoded single cells from each plate were pooled and distributed into sublibraries. processed 72-165 sublibraries per plate total 1 786 sublibraries. obtained 1.4 trillion raw sequencing reads representing 153 million cells. after filtering 100.6 million cells pass minimal filters and 95.6 million cells pass full filters.

mosaic platform cultured spheroids consisting of a mixture of 50 cancer cell lines subjected to drug treatments including dmso vehicle controls for 24 hours dissociated fixed and profiled using parse gigalab kit combinatorial barcoding scrna-seq . snp-based deconvolution assigned cells to cell line of origin.

components.name: method
values: vision differential gene set scoring | computed gene-set expression scores at cell level using vision detomaso et al. 2019 then differential score between aggregated treatment and control conditions.
